title: stripe listen forwards events in your account's default API version, not the version your code pins
symptoms: Local webhook payloads differ in shape from what the production endpoint receives
Passing --stripe-version to stripe trigger does not change the forwarded event
cause: The listen command can only render events in the account default API version, or the latest one with --latest. The version used for trigger or other API requests does not control how events are formatted.
fix: Use --latest when your code targets the newest version, or upgrade the account default. For an exact older version, tunnel to a real webhook endpoint created with that api_version.
affected: Stripe CLI, all versions through October 2026; the request for a version flag on listen is still open
